archived_experiment_accounting.note: Unique observed attempt IDs only, excluding selected completed workflows. Missing remote calls and conflicting observations are not zero. Historical evaluation costs are not the current H2 experiment. Never add duplicate recovery snapshots.

guidance.evaluation_guidance: Inspect discordant answers against scenario evidence; neither evaluator wins by default. A Decision-first/escalate-to-GPT policy is a future design to test, not a measured result.
guidance.evaluator_signal: 48/50 same-answer agreements; 0 Decision-only accepts and 2 GPT-only accepts. 47 fully priced matched evaluator pairs.
guidance.guidance: Observed mean whole-workflow cost and elapsed time both favor Decision routing. Prioritize a controlled follow-up; preserved quality is still unproven.
guidance.next_measurement: Hold code, workers, evidence and settings fixed; counterbalance routing order; repeat matched prompts. Prespecify a quality-equivalence margin and use independent labels to measure false accepts/rejects. Include handler checking/rework time.
guidance.quality_signal: 23/25 fully judged workflow pairs had both answers accepted by both evaluators; this is not correctness.
guidance.routing_signal: 17/22 same-settings, live-completed pairs had lower observed total cost AND elapsed time with Decision routing.

limitations: Every complete binary triple has a2-of3 majority; this alone is not a clear win.
Majorities are derived exploratory judgments, not replacements or ground truth.
The90 answers were selected on original disagreement; population agreement is not estimated.
No majority is reported for an incomplete triple; unknowns are not negative votes.
All prior judgments and reports remain unchanged; no correctness or savings claim is made.
Repeated calls to the same model are not independent experts or calibrated confidence.
Model/settings changes are disclosed; accounting includes physical attempts and unknowns.
H1 and H2 are exploratory, not confirmed. No quality-equivalence margin or independent correctness labels were specified.
Selected recovery successes, runtime changes and nonconcurrent execution can confound routing comparisons, even within matched recorded settings.
One execution per prompt/arm: intervals describe variation across these prompts, not repeat-run reliability or a population sample.
Both evaluators are models, not ground truth. Agreement and consensus acceptance do not establish correctness or preserved quality.
H2 token caps differ (GPT 8192; Decision-1 2048). Both receive the same binary task, but this is not a controlled equal-budget comparison.
Fixed-study-v1 prices are study assumptions, not vendor invoices. Hosting, network and human checking/correction are unmeasured.
Unknown cost/time is never zero. Complete-cost comparisons exclude unpriced pairs and explicitly report their denominator.
All physical calls and internal repairs belong to their selected completed workflow/evaluation. Replaced workflows are separate archived spending.
Offline-revalidated answers retain original recorded elapsed time; recovery did not measure a new successful end-to-end execution.
Failure rates are operational diagnostics, not another hypothesis, a negative model vote or a coverage gate.
95% prompt-cluster bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for multiple comparisons; boundary/very small samples can give misleadingly narrow intervals.
